title: Anilino-carbazole-based D–π–D′–π–D blue light material coordinated exciplex for achieving white light dynamic regulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41471-41478
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04330A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaoling Xie, Junfeng Wang, Haocheng Zhao, Zhenrui Gao, Lei Yan, Yuling Wu, Yanqin Miao
Controllable warm-to-cold white light transition was achieved in CzPAF-DPA single-molecule devices by adjusting the emitting layer thickness and utilizing its interface exciplex, fabricated by both vacuum evaporation deposition and wet spin-coating.
